title: OnePass Mobile 365 Days 5G Prepaid SIM - 600GB $199 Delivered (Free OnePass Included) @ OnePass Mobile
body:
Deal: OnePass Mobile 365 Days 5G Prepaid SIM - 600GB $199 Delivered (Free OnePass Included) @ OnePass Mobile

[Quarter Pounder] 150mbps speed cap FYI, perfectly fine for the average user. Wish there weren't speed caps though.
[MasterScythe] Even for a power user 150Mbps is stonkingly fast on a phone. Especially since mobile networks typically use burst throttling (unlimited speed for X seconds, then throttle).
Means small things like apps or webpages load instantly but yeah, ripping down the latest torrent will take 15 minutes.
[Quarter Pounder] No, mobile networks use AMBR, which is aggregate maximum bit rate. The burst you see lasts less than a second at good signal, on lower signal, the AMBR cap can take slightly longer to kick in.
[MasterScythe] 100% correct, i worded thay very poorly. Appreciate the correction.
The function was correct though. Bursts will often exceed any limit, meaning that single bursts like loading a message, a webpage, or similar can still feel instant.
But you're right, its a limit of the tech not a feature offered.
[Phoebus] If your phone is the internet gateway for a house full of uni students then the speed cap could be an issue
[hashtagbargain] nope none of the plans from OnePass have free international calling.
[ksheep] No, and you can't even receive SMS when overseas in many countries.
[bargainben] The wife just churned to the previous deal. Optus phone reception was an improvement over Tangerine on the commute. Any good cashback deals for this?
[scalebearer] That would make it $180 after cashback, which translates to $15 per month, for 600GB of data, an average of 50GB per month, on Optus 5G.
Not bad at all. The deal should be amended to highlight the extra 10% off.
[ScribbleSass] With $75 cashback, this seems to be a good deal too: https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/977921
[ce5himm] I only need 150gb wish I can pay $50,lol
[WatchNerd] Kogan is $159 for 300GB which uses the Vodafone network.
[ScribbleSass] It's the rebranded Catch Connect which was in market for long. No issues.
[Crowing] Is it possible to do data share with this plan? Ie for Apple Watch. I was reading but couldn’t see anything about this as add on option
[shutuptakemymoney101] Pretty good price for 600GB on Optus network if you don't need o/s calls and text.
This is the absolute icing on the cake though, what a relief ;-)

[jmel] showing $275 340GB 365DAY PLAN in my cart. Is it because I am an existing onepass mobile customer?
[shxhshzhz] The intro offer is for new services porting in or getting a new number
[jmel] I've already got one service with them, and if I port over another number, I should be eligible for the 600GB?
[bargainsinabundance] @shxhshzhz: I have a one pass mobile account but not a current service, I have a Boost service currently. Showing as $275 340GB 365DAY PLAN in my cart. Should it be showing as 600GB?
[shxhshzhz] @bargainsinabundance: It could be a glitch. That should count as a new service. You can try contacting them tomorrow
[bargainsinabundance] @shxhshzhz: Thanks so much for getting back to me. Will contact them tomorrow morning.
[TheTwo] What does it say under Manage > Overview then Usage and Allowances?
[Woody123] If i currently have onepass, will this auto extend mine for another year?
[sophiie] Anyone else have issues with receiving SMS overseas ?
[ksheep] Yes, varies by country. Support told me if roaming was important to me then to switch provider … Which you can't do when you can't receive SMS overseas. Sigh.
Cannot receive in USA, Bahamas or Japan. Can in Canada, Sweden, South Korea.
[Mydc5r] Switch provider as in no optus network? Must be Telstra or Voda ?
[deltasgerbil12] Why can’t they have eSIM? Is it not cheaper than mailing SIMs?
[jmel] How is this compared to Kogan's Vodaphone? https://www.kogan.com/au/buy/kogan-mobile-365-day-prepaid-pl…
Have never used Voda's network, keen to hear feedback
[shutuptakemymoney101] Like every other telco YMMV, best to buy a discounted sim and trial the network for a month before jumping in to a 12 month plan.
People throw a lot of shade at Vodafone but the network is great around my area and in the areas frequently travel, for us anyway the network is a strong consideration each year when we renew our plans.
[shrugies] Would never go back to Kogan (or any Vodafone) again. My wife who was with catch connect had better connectivity and faster data even though we’re on similar ages phones and sitting right next to each other
[teatea] because it's the lesser used network, it's also less likely going to be congested. My experience was positive until they blocked my phone and extended that block to Optus and Telstra. That was a nightmare to unblock.
[DAnn0] I don't think the Kogan plan you linked to is 5g but the onepass deal here is, correct me if I'm wrong
[432860] Can I use this plan as data only..in a 4g modem router?
[Phoebus] Unless you're a big newsnet or torrent or 4k netflix user, you probably won't need a home internet subscription with this.
Perhaps a bit of an exaggeration, but doable if you keep your video streams to 480p and you're not watching more than an hour of video per day
[2Fast2Fuhrious] Used this for a month between plans, worked well
[JinXR] I have the 4g version of this - $139.
Never again.
[shxhshzhz] Network quality depends entirely on where you are. Some people have very good service from the Optus network, some don't, some have better with Telstra, some don't, some don't get good quality with Vodafone. Bad service for one person does not mean it will be bad for everyone else.
[shxhshzhz] Activate SIM by 10/12/2026 to receive bonus data inclusions.
[mttk1853] I have added the $199 600GB plan into the cart and am ready to pay, but it shows "$275 340GB 365DAY PLAN", should I be concerned?
[shxhshzhz] No reason for concern as long as it shows a $199 price. That is the name of the plan.
